safety_verdicts.content: Massage and warm baths did not relieve the symptoms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions trying massage/hot baths but does not clearly state they did not relieve the left arm symptoms (no explicit lack of benefit documented).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether massage/warm baths helped is supportive context for musculoskeletal vs neurologic etiologies, but it rarely changes urgent management of progressive numbness/weakness. Omission may slightly reduce clarity of the symptom course and prior self-care response.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Ibuprofen use is not listed in the generated medication list.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Missing ibuprofen use can affect medication reconciliation and safety screening (e.g., renal disease, GI bleed risk, anticoagulants, pregnancy), and can also obscure what has already been tried for symptom relief. In most cases this leads to additional questioning rather than direct harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document denial of neck pain.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting denial of neck pain helps distinguish cervical radiculopathy/spine pathology from peripheral entrapment or central causes; omission can weaken diagnostic reasoning and downstream triage/workup planning. However, clinicians typically re-ask key ROS elements when neuro red flags are present.
